# 1. Load Libraries
```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Rsubread)
library(tidyverse)

cat("Rsubread version:", as.character(packageVersion("Rsubread")), "\n")
```

# 2. Verify BAM Files
```{r verify-bams}
bam_dir   <- "04_alignment/bam_files"
bam_files <- list.files(bam_dir, pattern = "_fixed\\.bam$", full.names = TRUE)

cat("BAM files found:", length(bam_files), "\n")

if (length(bam_files) == 20) {
  cat("All 20 samples present\n")
} else {
  cat("Expected 20 BAM files — check alignment output\n")
}
```

# 3. Verify GTF Annotation File
```{r verify-gtf}
gtf_file <- "03_genome_reference/annotation/gencode.v47.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf"

if (file.exists(gtf_file)) {
  cat("GTF found\n")
  cat("  Size:", round(file.info(gtf_file)$size / (1024^3), 2), "GB\n")
} else {
  stop("GTF not found — run Script 00 to decompress reference files")
}
```

# 4. Quantification with featureCounts

**Estimated time: 30-60 min**

**To run:** change `eval=FALSE` to `eval=TRUE`.
```{r quantification, eval=FALSE}
cat("Starting quantification...\n")
cat("Start:", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")

fc <- featureCounts(
  files               = bam_files,
  annot.ext           = gtf_file,
  isGTFAnnotationFile = TRUE,
  GTF.featureType     = "exon",     # count reads overlapping exons
  GTF.attrType        = "gene_id",  # aggregate counts at gene level
  isPairedEnd         = TRUE,       # paired-end library
  nthreads            = 4
)

cat("\nQuantification complete\n")
cat("End:", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), "\n")

# Save featureCounts output object
save(fc, file = "05_quantification/counts/featureCounts_results.RData")
cat("Results saved\n")
```

# 5. Explore Results
```{r explore-results}
load("05_quantification/counts/featureCounts_results.RData")

counts <- fc$counts

cat("Genes:   ", nrow(counts), "\n")
cat("Samples: ", ncol(counts), "\n\n")

cat("Assignment statistics:\n")
print(fc$stat)
```

# 6. Clean and Save Count Matrix
```{r save-counts}
# Strip full path from column names, keep sample ID only
colnames(counts) <- gsub(".*/", "", colnames(counts))
colnames(counts) <- gsub("_fixed\\.bam$", "", colnames(counts))

cat("Sample names:\n")
print(colnames(counts))

# Convert to data frame and save
counts_df         <- as.data.frame(counts)
counts_df$gene_id <- rownames(counts_df)
counts_df         <- counts_df[, c("gene_id", colnames(counts))]

write.csv(counts_df,
          "05_quantification/counts/raw_counts_matrix.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nCount matrix saved: raw_counts_matrix.csv\n")
```

# 7. Summary
```{r summary}
counts_file <- "05_quantification/counts/raw_counts_matrix.csv"

if (file.exists(counts_file)) {
  cat("===================================\n")
  cat("Quantification complete\n")
  cat("  Genes:  ", nrow(counts_df), "\n")
  cat("  Samples:", ncol(counts_df) - 1, "\n")
  cat("\nNext: Script 04_differential_expression_DESeq2\n")
} else {
  cat("Run Section 4 first\n")
}
```
